key_facts: Jaguar unveiled its first new all-electric model, the Type 01 Grand Tourer, in New York, marking the company's radical shift to an all-electric luxury brand after two years of controversy over its 'woke' rebranding campaign.
The Type 01 produces approximately 1,000 horsepower, accelerates from 0-62mph in 3.2 seconds, and has a range of up to 320 miles at sustained highway speed, with a minimum price of £130,000.
JLR wound down production of old Jaguar models in 2024-2025 and is investing £15bn in new models and technologies as part of a wider restructuring strategy announced in early 2023.

The Type 01 is expected to be the first of three new electric designs from Jaguar, with success contingent on finding buyers willing to pay premium prices in a competitive market including Porsche, Mercedes-AMG, and Chinese brands like Denza.

key_facts: Equinor, part-owner of Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas fields, has warned it may withdraw from further UK investments if these fields are not approved.

Rosebank is the UK's largest undeveloped oil and gas field, located 80 miles north-west of the Shetland Islands and thought to hold up to 500 million barrels of oil and gas; the exploration licence was granted in 2001, discovery made in 2004, and final investment decision in 2023.
UK production is forecast to halve by 2035, and the country already relies on Norway for half of its gas needs.

Following a public consultation closed in August, Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh is set to make the final decision on both Rosebank and Jackdaw, which were initially approved by the former Conservative government but delayed by a Scottish court ruling over climate impact considerations.
importance_reason: Major investment threat to UK energy infrastructure with systemic implications for energy security and North Sea development; decision carries political significance within Labour's climate commitments.
market_link: UK gas prices and energy security; potential supply constraints affecting 2035 energy outlook; investment climate for North Sea operators.

Froyo tubs are priced up to £12, and the European frozen yoghurt market is estimated at £434m in 2026, up from £419m in 2025 according to Market Data Forecast.

The dessert was hugely popular in the UK in the late 2000s and early 2010s but declined by the end of that decade due to market over-saturation and consumer realisation that froyo may not be as healthy as initially perceived.

Industry experts attribute the current revival to 2010s nostalgia trends and social media virality, with froyo viewed as an 'experiential moment' and 'affordable luxury' rather than merely a food product.

key_facts: Jonathan Blow, creator of the 2008 puzzle-platformer Braid, has spent ten years developing Order of the Sinking Star, which he estimates contains approximately 1,500 puzzles and could take around 500 hours to complete.

The game is built on the mechanics of four pre-existing free puzzle games from other designers, whose mechanics are combined to create new puzzles—for example, mechanics from Alan Hazelden's Mirror Isles (2014) and Skipping Stones to Lonely Homes are blended together.

Blow created his own programming language, Jai, and a custom engine to develop the game rather than using pre-built engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine, stating the custom approach allowed him to build something 'tuned and authored very specifically' to his vision.

Blow has rejected the use of AI in the development pipeline for Order of the Sinking Star, expressing scepticism about productivity claims and concerns that future developers may rely too heavily on AI for coding rather than learning programming fundamentals.

key_facts: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva stated that artificial intelligence is 'rapidly becoming a key driver of countries' relative fortunes in the world economy,' but the combination of AI advancement, soaring energy costs, and record public debt is challenging global growth this decade.

Georgieva said global AI investment as a share of GDP will reach and likely exceed amounts that went into building railroads, electricity grids, or telecommunications networks, with AI hardware and related technology products already accounting for more than a tenth of world goods trade.

The IMF estimates that AI could add up to half a percentage point to annual world growth, which Georgieva said would be equivalent to adding an economy the size of ASEAN to the world economy over a decade.

Global public debt is near its highest level since World War II and on track to soon exceed 100% of GDP, with higher interest rates ending the 17-year period when interest rates stayed below growth rates, making debt reduction without fiscal effort 'out of reach in the near term.'

The RBI changed its policy stance to 'calibrated tightening' and expects core inflation at 4.4% and headline inflation at 5.2% for the financial year ending March 2027.

The RBI raised its economic growth estimate by 40 basis points to 7.1% for the current financial year, though the World Bank expects growth to moderate to 7.1% in the next financial year from 7.8% previously.

key_facts: San Francisco start-up Rainmaker conducted a cloud-seeding experiment in Homer, Alaska in August without widespread resident notification, claiming to have produced 19 million US gallons of water in three hours using silver iodide dispersal via drones.

Cloud-seeding technology, developed since 1946, involves dispersing compounds such as silver iodide into clouds to form ice crystals that eventually fall as rain or snow; the process requires ideal climate environments such as mountainous or cold regions.

Rainmaker releases 20 grams of silver iodide per flight distributed across thousands of square kilometres, resulting in ground concentration increases in parts per quadrillion, according to CEO Augustus Doricko.
Cloud seeding produces approximately an extra 5-10% of precipitation under right conditions; Rainmaker's 19 million gallons equates to around 0.01 inch of rain across 100 square miles.
More than 50 countries are developing weather modification programmes; Recast Systems is testing a biodegradable protein-based seeding agent made from amino acids as an alternative to silver iodide.
importance_reason: Emerging technology with localized environmental/water security implications, but limited immediate market or macroeconomic impact; represents sector innovation rather than systemic economic shock.

key_facts: Operation Metro Surge, an ICE enforcement action in Minneapolis from early December to mid-February, resulted in a nearly 3% decline in weekly foot traffic and over 6% drawdown in spending in affected cities, according to University of Pennsylvania analysis, totaling around 8 billion fewer visits and billions in lost spending.

The Lake Street Council documented that immigrant-owned businesses in the commercial district cumulatively lost $46 million in December and January; the City of Minneapolis estimated nearly $700 million in lost economic activity between December and April from the surge.

A Brookings Institution analysis found that six months after respective surges, the most-impacted cities had a 0.4% employment shortfall; Minnesota's labor force participation rate fell faster than the U.S. overall, and the state's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate in 2026 eclipsed the national average for the first time in about 19 years.

Colonial Market owner Daniel Hernandez reported sales declined by roughly 60% at his stores; he shuttered one location on Lake Street after it became known as a hangout spot for ICE officers, having invested savings and borrowed money against his house to open the store two years prior.
importance_reason: Regional economic impact from policy enforcement with documented effects on employment, business closure, and local GDP; localized but measurable recession-like conditions affecting specific communities.

key_facts: Five former Barclays traders—Jay Merchant, Jonathan Mathew, Philippe Moryoussef, Alex Pabon, Colin Bermingham—had their convictions overturned by the Court of Appeal on Wednesday following a long-running legal battle.

The traders were originally convicted of conspiracy to defraud for allegedly manipulating Libor and Euribor interest rate mechanisms used to set borrowing costs on mortgages, car finance, and other loans.

The convictions were quashed after Tom Hayes (UBS) and Carlo Palombo won appeals at the Supreme Court in July 2025, establishing precedent that prosecutors had wrongly pursued normal commercial practices to appease public anger over the 2008 financial crisis.

The Serious Fraud Office, which brought the original case, has not opposed the appeals; as of this ruling, only two traders—Christian Bittar (Deutsche Bank) and Peter Johnson (Barclays)—retain convictions over interest rate rigging.
importance_reason: High-profile reversal of financial crisis-era convictions signals shift in legal precedent for rate-rigging prosecutions, though market impact is retrospective rather than forward-looking.

key_facts: UK cereal harvest was the lowest on record, with wheat down about three million tonnes or 11% according to AHDB. In the South West, impacts were far worse: Charles Day's family farm wheat harvest was about 50% down, and most cereal farmers in the region saw harvests down at least 30%, with spring barley and beans down more than 50%.

Dairy production fell just 4.5% overall, but costs surged significantly: Sarah Godwin's family farm spent around £100,000 on emergency feed and silage, £20,000 on reduced production yields, and £15,000 on cooling systems for cattle; Tom Kimber's farm cut only two of three expected winter silage clamps.
This is the fourth drought in eight years in the region. Climate scientist Mike Kendon states that 'what we used to think of as extreme weather, we increasingly consider as normal.'

A government grants programme for environmental farming support worth £250m was exhausted in under six hours when the latest financing round opened, described by farmer Tom Collins as 'reminiscent of Glastonbury ticket sales.'

НФС признал ООО «Б1-Аудит» удовлетворяющим требованиям к независимости и принял решение предложить проведение обязательного аудита годовой финансовой отчетности Банка России за 2026 год указанной организацией.
importance_reason: Рутинное заседание регулятора с обсуждением плановых документов развития денежно-кредитной политики и текущих вопросов надзора без объявления конкретных решений по ставкам и инструментам политики.
